mapper.sql: id, user_id, title, content, type, related_id, related_type, is_read, create_time, read_time, is_deleted
mapper.select: SELECT n.id, n.user_id, u.name AS user_name, n.title, n.content, n.type, n.related_id, n.related_type, n.is_read, n.create_time, n.read_time FROM system_notice n LEFT JOIN user_info u ON n.user_id = u.id WHERE n.id = #{id} AND n.is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO system_notice ( user_id, title, content, type, related_id, related_type, is_read, create_time, is_deleted ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{type}, #{relatedId}, #{relatedType}, 0, NOW(), 0 )

INSERT INTO system_notice ( user_id, title, content, type, related_id, related_type, is_read, create_time, is_deleted ) VALUES
